review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Add a bounded resize grip to Chat’s live terminal preview without intercepting terminal or conversation scrolling elsewhere
review.notes: Grounded in the supplied iPhone screenshot and the working-row disclosure. Synthetic tests verify responder and accessibility behavior, viewport bounds, and scope. Native gesture feel needs separate rendered acceptance.

cases.description: The live terminal grip grows upward and reveals earlier lines within the Chat viewport
cases.setup: Open a synthetic working conversation with more than 40 captured rows. Supply a measured Chat viewport, then a smaller one.
cases.action: Use the resize responder and its accessible increase/decrease actions. Inspect measured preview bounds and visible lines.
cases.expected: Upward drag expands the local preview and exposes additional earlier output without losing the latest row. A downward drag shrinks it. Orientation/keyboard bounds clamp effective height and restoring space restores the selected size. The height control is limited to the grip.

cases.description: Preview resizing stays with the current live conversation scope
cases.setup: Open a working conversation, resize it, and refresh its capture. Offer an idle observation and then a different conversation.
cases.action: Fold and reopen the preview, transiently hide the working row, and switch to another pane.
cases.expected: The selection survives redraw, folding and temporary idle within the same scope. A new scope starts folded at the default size. Resizing does not create an input action or change pane identity.
